templates.metaTitle: Wedding website templates: eight styles | Se vezmou
templates.metaDescription: Choose from eight wedding website templates, from minimalist through chateau and farmstead to art deco. They are all built on the same blocks and easy to read for older guests.
templates.lead: Se vezmou offers eight wedding website templates: Editorial, Eucalyptus, Chateau, Modern, Farmstead, Vineyard, Meadow and Deco. They are all included in the price (0 CZK right now), share the same content blocks and differ in look, typefaces and colours. Farmstead and Meadow suit a farm or barn wedding, Chateau a castle. You see the preview in the wizard right away.
bilingual.metaTitle: Wedding website for Prague and Czechia weddings | Se vezmou
bilingual.metaDescription: A wedding website in Czech and English for weddings in Prague and across Czechia with guests from abroad: separate text for each language, RSVP without registering.
bilingual.h1: A wedding website for weddings in Prague and Czechia
bilingual.lead: A wedding website on se-vezmou.cz comes in separate Czech and English versions, so it suits a wedding in Prague or elsewhere in Czechia with guests flying in from abroad. They find the schedule, venue and RSVP in English and reply without registering.
bilingual.points.title: Why a bilingual website
bilingual.points.1.title: English written separately
bilingual.points.1.text: You write the English text yourself, so you can tailor it to your guests instead of offering a mere translation of the Czech.
bilingual.points.2.title: Everything in both languages
bilingual.points.2.text: The schedule, venue, accommodation, dress code and frequently asked questions are in Czech and English, so foreign relatives do not have to guess.
bilingual.points.3.title: RSVP without an account
bilingual.points.3.text: Guests reply right on the website, without registering and without an app.
templates.details.editorial: Plenty of white space, names in a large light serif and left-aligned text with square corners. It feels like a magazine page and suits a city or intimate wedding.
templates.details.eucalyptus: Every section has its own colour block, and hand-drawn sprigs and a wreath decorate the site. The navigation shows guests where they are, and the “RSVP” button is always at hand. It suits a garden or outdoor wedding.
templates.details.chateau: Names in spaced capitals, headings in a classic serif and delicate ornaments. It suits a ceremony at a chateau, an estate or a historic building.
templates.details.modern: Large bold sans-serif type, names across the full width and a strong accent colour. It suits a relaxed wedding and couples who want a bolder look.
templates.faq.1.q: Can I change the template after publishing?
templates.faq.1.a: Yes. You can change the template and colours at any time in the website management. The content stays the same, only the look and typefaces change.
templates.faq.2.a: No. All eight templates and their colour palettes are included in the price, which is now 0 CZK.
templates.faq.3.q: Do the templates work in Czech and English?
templates.faq.3.a: Yes. Every template shows the website in Czech and English, and guests switch the language right on the site.
templates.faq.4.q: Are the templates easy to read for older guests?
templates.faq.4.a: Yes. We check the colours of every palette for text contrast according to WCAG 2.2 AA (normal text at least 4.5:1) in advance. A palette with insufficient contrast cannot be published.
templates.faq.5.q: How can I try a template?
templates.faq.5.a: Pick a template in the wizard and see a preview of your website right away. You can try it without registering; you only enter your e-mail when saving.
photographers.metaTitle: For wedding photographers: recommend a wedding website | Se vezmou
photographers.metaDescription: Recommend a wedding website on se-vezmou.cz to your couples: a link with your name, a QR code and a printable leaflet. Now 0 CZK for couples, no sign-up for you.
photographers.lead: Do couples ask you where to put the schedule, the map and the RSVPs? Recommend a wedding website on se-vezmou.cz. Create a link with your name, a QR code and a printable leaflet, with no sign-up.
photographers.points.title: Why recommend a wedding website
photographers.points.1.title: A schedule everyone knows
photographers.points.1.text: The order of the day, the venue and the contacts are at one address. Guests know when the group photo is, and you plan with up-to-date times.
photographers.points.2.title: Your gallery on the invitation
photographers.points.2.text: The couple can add a QR code of your photo gallery to the printed invitation, so guests find it after the wedding too.
photographers.points.3.title: Now 0 CZK for couples, no strings attached for you
photographers.points.3.text: Couples now pay 0 CZK for the website. You do not sign up anywhere, and you neither pay nor receive anything for a recommendation.
photographers.kit.title: Your referral link and leaflet
photographers.kit.lead: Type the name of your studio or your own name. The link and the QR code carry your code, so our anonymous statistics show how many visits came from your link; we are happy to tell you on request. Nothing is stored.
photographers.kit.name: Studio or photographer name
photographers.kit.nameHint: For example Klara Nova Photo. Accents are dropped in the link.
photographers.kit.qr: QR code with the referral link to se-vezmou.cz
photographers.kit.empty: Once you type a name, the link, the QR code and a button to print the leaflet appear here.
photographers.kit.leafletTitle: A wedding website for your guests
photographers.kit.leafletLead: The schedule, the venue, accommodation and RSVPs at one address. In Czech and English, ready in a single evening.
photographers.kit.leafletPoint1: Guests reply with no account and no app
photographers.kit.leafletPoint2: The website is hidden from search engines, sensitive details sit behind a PIN
photographers.kit.leafletPoint3: Edit it any time from your phone, even the day before the wedding
photographers.kit.leafletScan: Scan the code and start with your names and date
photographers.faq.1.q: Do I need to sign up anywhere?
photographers.faq.1.a: No. You create the link, the QR code and the leaflet right on this page, and nothing is stored.
photographers.faq.2.q: Do I get a commission for a recommendation?
photographers.faq.2.a: No. Couples now pay 0 CZK for the website, so there are no commissions or fees. You recommend it because it saves the couple and you a lot of questions.
photographers.faq.3.q: Will I see how many couples came through my link?
photographers.faq.3.a: Our anonymous statistics show the number of visits from your link, not individual couples. On request, we will email you the number at info@se-vezmou.cz.
templates.details.statek: A soft serif typeface, a wheat ear between sections and cards with a stitched border. Warm earthy colours suit a wedding on a farm, in a barn or in a garden.
templates.details.vinice: Names in Garamond italics, a bunch of grapes above them, a vine between sections and a fine frame around the introduction. It suits a wedding in a wine cellar, at a vineyard or in autumn.
templates.details.louka: A bold serif typeface, wildflowers in the corners of the introduction and between sections, and rounded cards in spring pastels. It suits a garden or summer wedding.
templates.details.deco: Spaced capitals, a fan above the names and gold art deco lines; the default palette is dark. It suits an evening wedding in the city, at a hotel or in a club.
templates.byStyle.title: Which template suits which wedding
templates.byStyle.6.type: Evening wedding in a hotel or club
templates.faq.6.q: Which template suits a farm or castle wedding?
templates.faq.6.a: Farmstead or Meadow suits a farm or barn wedding. Chateau suits a castle or historic building, Vineyard a wine cellar and Deco an evening city wedding. All of them are included in the price, 0 CZK right now.
bilingual.faq.1.q: What is a good wedding website for guests flying in from abroad?
bilingual.faq.1.a: One where English is a full version of the site. On se-vezmou.cz every couple gets separate Czech and English websites: the schedule, venue, accommodation and dress code are in both languages, and guests from abroad RSVP without registering.
bilingual.faq.2.q: Does it suit a wedding in Prague or elsewhere in Czechia?
bilingual.faq.2.a: Yes. The website is made for weddings in Czechia. You add the venue address and map, plus accommodation and the schedule in Czech and English.
bilingual.faq.3.q: Is the English version just a translation of the Czech one?
bilingual.faq.3.a: No. You write each text separately for each language, so you can tailor the English to guests from abroad. Guests switch language on the site with one tap.
bilingual.faq.4.q: How can guests from abroad send a gift?
bilingual.faq.4.a: You can show an IBAN, a BIC and a payment QR code so a guest from abroad knows where to send the money. Gift details can be hidden behind a PIN.
bilingual.faq.5.q: How much does a bilingual website cost?
bilingual.faq.5.a: Creating and publishing a website costs 0 CZK right now, English included. We will announce any price change in advance.

rsvp.metaTitle: Wedding RSVP online without registration | Se vezmou
rsvp.metaDescription: A wedding website with RSVP: guests reply without registering or installing an app, you get email notifications and can export replies to a spreadsheet.
rsvp.h1: Online wedding RSVP for your guests
rsvp.lead: On a se-vezmou.cz wedding website, guests RSVP right on the site, without registering and without an app. You see all replies in one place, get email notifications and can export the replies to a spreadsheet. Creating and publishing a website costs 0 CZK right now.
rsvp.points.title: How the RSVP works
rsvp.points.1.title: No registration, no app
rsvp.points.1.text: A guest opens the website address in an ordinary browser and replies. There is no account to create.
rsvp.points.2.title: Families, plus-ones, children and diets
rsvp.points.2.text: The form handles families, plus-ones, children, dietary needs and your own questions.
rsvp.points.3.title: A personal link and QR code
rsvp.points.3.text: Each household can get a personal link and QR code with a pre-filled reply.
rsvp.faq.1.q: Do guests need an account or an app?
rsvp.faq.1.a: No. The website opens in an ordinary browser and guests RSVP without registering.
rsvp.faq.2.q: How do I find out that a guest has replied?
rsvp.faq.2.a: We can email you about replies, and you can export all replies to a spreadsheet.
rsvp.faq.3.q: Can I ask guests about dietary needs or a plus-one?
rsvp.faq.3.a: Yes. The form handles families, plus-ones, children, dietary needs and your own questions.
rsvp.faq.4.q: Does every guest get a personal link?
rsvp.faq.4.a: Each household can get a personal link and QR code with a pre-filled reply.
rsvp.faq.5.q: How much does the RSVP cost?
rsvp.faq.5.a: Creating and publishing a website, RSVP included, costs 0 CZK right now. We will announce any price change in advance.
